description: This file contains the implementation of error handling middleware for the Slim PHP framework, specifically the ErrorMiddleware class which manages exceptions, error handlers, and their configuration.

classes.name: ErrorMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles exceptions and errors within the Slim framework, providing mechanisms to set custom error handlers and manage error processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ErrorMiddleware with dependencies such as resolver, response factory, and configuration flags.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles incoming server request and wraps the handler execution to catch exceptions, delegating to handleException if needed.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles an exception thrown during request processing, selecting an appropriate error handler and executing it.

methods.name: getErrorHandler
methods.description: Retrieves an error handler based on the type of exception, considering specific handlers, subclass handlers, or falling back to default.

methods.name: getDefaultErrorHandler
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the default ErrorHandler instance.

methods.name: setDefaultErrorHandler
methods.description: Allows setting a custom default error handler callable or object.

methods.name: setErrorHandler
methods.description: Assigns error handlers for specific exception types or multiple types, optionally handling subclasses.

methods.name: addErrorHandler
methods.description: Internal helper to add a single error handler for a specific exception type, either directly or for subclasses.
